text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey!! Nakayama!! What's the meaning of 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me that "What is it?"! A ton of 
flowers got sent to the dorm!! Under 
Nakayama's name!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Looks like I won the bet, then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's going on? This whole room 
smells super floral. Did you lose a bet to 
change jobs to a florist?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No, that's actually your birthday 
present... Though, I did close my eyes 
when typing in the order quantity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whether it would be a "surprising" present 
or not came down to luck. A single bouquet 
of flowers would've been way too ordinary, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I was spooked, it's just... 
knowing it's a present... ain't it kinda 
embarrassing?! I mean, a whole room full 
of flowers...?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! Sh-Shut up! Hey, don't look away! 
Wait, hey—!!
